references.text: Describes the south side of the courtyard with hangings and pillars, providing context for the measurements of the west side in verse 12.
Describes the north side of the courtyard with a similar construction of hangings, pillars, and bases.
Gives the total dimensions of the courtyard, including the width of fifty cubits mentioned in verse 12.
Parallel text describing the actual execution of the west side of the courtyard with fifty cubits of hanging, ten pillars, and ten bases.
Mentions copper bases under the tabernacle's planks, the same type of construction element used in the courtyard.
This shows the exact correspondence between God's instructions (27:12) and the actual execution of the work (38:15).
